name: Water jugs 8-5-3: get 7 litres into some jug
note: Jug A starts full (8 L); the goal is any jug holding 7 L. BFS returns a shortest plan of 5 pourings. DFS dives into the first pouring (A→B) each time and reaches 7 L only after 9 pourings: same goal, a longer plan, because DFS takes the first goal it dives into. Compare the path length and the solution table of the two runs.
